questions.question: Four numbers have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:-

**1) 4174 → 4 + 1 + 7 + 4 = 16 ⇒ Even**

2) 5459 → 5 + 4 + 5 + 9 = 23 ⇒ Odd

3) 2126 → 2 + 1 + 2 + 6 = 11 ⇒ Odd

questions.question: The four essential requirements for photosynthesis include:

options.text: Carbon dioxide, minerals, chlorophyll and sunlight
Chlorophyll, sunlight, carbon dioxide and water

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chlorophyll, sunlight, carbon dioxide, and water**__.

__
 
• **Photosynthesis **is the **process **by which **plants use sunlight, water**, and **carbon dioxide **to **create oxygen **and **energy **in the form of **sugar**.
 
• **Steps of photosynthesis**:

 
• **CO2 **and **H2O enter the leaf**.
 
• **Light hits **the **pigment **in the **membrane **of a **thylakoid, splitting the H2O into O2**.
 
• The **electrons move down to enzymes.**
 
• **Sunlight hits **the **second pigment molecule **allowing the **enzymes **to **convert ADP to ATP and NADP**+ **gets converted to NADPH**.
 
• **The ATP **and **NADPH **are used by the **Calvin cycle **as **a power source **for converting **carbon dioxide **from the **atmosphere **into **simple sugar glucose**.
 
• The **Calvin cycle **converts **3CO2 **molecules from the **atmosphere to glucose**.
 
• The **second of two major stages **in **photosynthesis **(following the light reactions), involves **atmospheric CO2 fixation **and **reduction **of the **fixed carbon into carbohydrates.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are **three main types **of **photosynthetic pathways: C3, C4, and CAM**. They all produce sugars from CO2 using the Calvin cycle, but each pathway is slightly different.
 
• **Green plants **and **trees **use **photosynthesis **to **make food **from **sunlight**, **carbon dioxide **and **water **in the **atmosphere**:
 
 
• It is **their primary source of energy**.
 
• The **importance of photosynthesis **in our **life **is the **oxygen it produces**.
 
• **Without photosynthesis**, there would be **little to no oxygen on the planet**.

questions.question: There are 3 pieces of wooden logs which are 48 m, 56 m and 72 m long. What is the greatest possible length by which these can be completely measured?
questions.solution:
**CONCEPT USED:**

Highest Common Factor(H.C.F)

**CALCULATION:**

Here, the length of the three pieces given is 48m, 56m, and 72 m respectively

⇒Greatest possible length of each plank = H.C.F (48, 56, 72) 

Prime factorization:

48 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 

56 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 7 

72 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 

⇒ H.C.F = Product of the smallest power of each common prime factor involved in the numbers = 2 × 2 × 2 = 8

**Hence, the greatest possible length of each plank is 8 m.**

questions.question: If the salary of A is 25% more than that of B, then how much per cent is the salary of B lower than that of A?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Salary of A = 25% more than that of B 

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume B's salary to be 100

⇒ Here, the Salary of A = 25% more than that of B 

⇒ Salary of A = 100 + 100 × 25/100 = 125 

⇒ Now, Salary of B lower than that of A = (Difference of A - Difference of B) = ( 125 - 100 ) = 25 

⇒ Required percent = (25/125) × 100 = 20% 

**Hence, the required percentage is 20%.**

questions.question: X and Y can complete a piece of work in 16 days, Y and Z can do the same piece of work in 24 days. X, Y and Z together can do it in 12 days. How much time will X and Z take to finish it?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

X and Y completes work = 16 days

Y and Z completes work = 24 days 

X, Y and Z together completes work = 12 days

**FORMULA USED:**

Efficiency = Total work done/ No. of days

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume the total work done be 48 unit

( you can assume any number , but for the sake of calculation, it is advised to take the L.C.M of the given numbers. Here L.C.M of 16, 24 and 12 = 48 )

As X and Y completes the work = 16 days

⇒ Efficiency of X and Y = 48/16 = 3 unit/ day

Now, Y and Z completes the work = 24 days

⇒ Efficiency of Y and Z = 48/24 = 2 unit/ day

Now, As X,Y and Z completes the work together = 12 days

⇒ Efficiency of X,Y and Z = 48/12 = 4 unit/day

Now, Efficiency of X =( Efficiency of X,Y and Z - Efficiency of Y and Z ) = ( 4 - 2 ) = 2 unit/day

 Efficiency of Z = ( Efficiency of X,Y and Z - Efficiency of X and Y ) = ( 4 - 3) = 1 unit/day

⇒ Total Efficiencies of X and Z = ( 2 +1) = 3 unit / day

Since, total work = 48 unit

⇒ No. of days taken by X and Z to complete the work = 48/3 = 16 days.

**Hence, X and Z takes 16 days to finish the work.**

questions.question: The technology that provides high internet speed over telephone wiring is called:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**ADSL**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **ADSL**

 
 
• **Asymmetric Digital Subscriber Line (ADSL)** is a technology that enables** high-bandwidth, fast data transmission** to homes and businesses over **copper wire telephone wirings**. 
 
• ADSL is **asymmetric**, as it uses the majority of its channels to **transport data downstream to the user and only a tiny portion of them to upload data from the user**.
 
• On the same phone line, ADSL supports both** analogue (voice) and digital (data) traffic**.
 
• It is usually provided with downstream internet connection data speeds ranging from **512 Kbps to around 6 Mb/s**.
 
• Compared to a conventional dial-up connection, it is a** more affordable way to access the internet at faster speeds**.
 
• **Download and upload speeds **are not similar in ADSL technology.
 
• The **Digital Subscriber Line (DSL)** modem's primary function while using an ADSL connection is to download the content; it is not intended to distribute it to others.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In order to **enable simultaneous usage of the landline and the ADSL modem**, ADSL operates on existing copper phone lines by utilising **a DSL filter, also known as a splitter**, to isolate the bands with higher frequencies.
 
• The one-way nature of most multimedia communication, **in which a lot of data flows in the user's direction and just a little bit of interactive control data is returned**, is something that ADSL was created to take advantage of.
 
• **Symmetric Digital Subscriber Line (SDSL)**, which is less widespread, is different from ADSL.
 
• **SDSL**
 
 
• Broadband technology that **delivers data via a phone network** is known as SDSL.
 
• SDSL, however, has** downstream bandwidth that is identical to upstream bandwidth** from the network to the subscriber.

• According to estimates, there are currently between **10 and 14 million species, of which more than 1.2 million have been researched and more than 86% have yet to be discovered**.
 
• **Causes of Extinction**
 
 
• Climate change
 
• Loss of habitat
 
• Diseases
 
• Lack of genetic diversity

questions.question: Pulling of the earth gravitationally in the same direction by the sun and the moon causes:
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Spring Tides**

 
 
• Pulling of the **earth gravitationally in the same direction by the sun and the moon **causes **spring tides**.
 
• When** lunar and solar tides align**, they reinforce one another and create a larger overall tidal.
 
• The** high tides in this instance are higher than usual, and the low tides are lower** than usual.
 
• Regardless of the season, spring tides happen** twice each lunar month**.
 
• Spring tides take place at the **new and full moons**.
 
• During the moon's quarter phases, the **bulges cancel each other out since the sun and moon are at a right angle to one another**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **High Tides**

 
 
• When the tide is high, it has** reached its highest point **and much of the shore is covered in water.
 
• This occurs as a body of **water approaches one of the two bulges produced by the moon's gravitational pull**.
 
 
 
• **Low Tides**
 
 
• At low tide, the **water recedes to its lowest point **and begins to move away from the beach.
 
• **Two bulges are created on Earth (and its oceans) **as a result of the moon's gravitational pull or tidal force: one at the location that is closest to the moon and the other on the side of the planet that is directly opposite the moon.
 
 
 
• **Neap Tides**
 
 
• **Seven days after a spring tide**, there is a period of** moderate tides known as a neap tide, which occurs when the sun and moon are at right angles to one another**.
 
• These tides also happen** twice a month**, just as spring tides.
 
• **Low tides are a little higher and high tides are a little lower** than usual during neap tide.
 
• When the moon is** "half full," in the first and third quarters**, neap tides occur.

questions.question: The sum of the four consecutive even numbers is 484. What would the smallest number be?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The average of the 4 consecutive even numbers = Sum ÷ 4 = 484 ÷ 4 = 121.

For an even number of consecutive terms, the average lies exactly midway between the two middle numbers.

Thus, the two middle even numbers adjacent to 121 are 120 and 122.

The sequence of the 4 even numbers is 118, 120, 122, and 124.

The smallest number in this sequence is 118.

**∴ The correct answer is 118.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of 4 consecutive even numbers = 484

 
• 
 
 
 
 

 118
 120
 122
 124

 x
 x+2
 x+4
 x+6

 
• 
 

 Average = 121
 (484 ÷ 4)

 Consecutive Even Numbers

**Calculations:**

Let the 4 consecutive even numbers be x, x + 2, x + 4, and x + 6.

⇒ Sum of the numbers = x + (x + 2) + (x + 4) + (x + 6) = 484

⇒ 4x + 12 = 484

⇒ 4x = 484 − 12

⇒ 4x = 472

⇒ x = 472 ÷ 4

⇒ x = 118

Since x is the smallest term in the sequence, the smallest number is 118.

**∴ The correct answer is 118.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average of an Arithmetic Progression (AP)

The average of terms in an AP is exactly equal to the average of the first and last terms: Average = (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2. It also represents the exact middle point of the distribution.

Sum of Terms in an AP

The sum of n terms can be calculated using the formula: Sₙ = n ÷ 2 × [2a + (n − 1)d], where 'a' is the first term and 'd' is the common difference.

Consecutive Even / Odd Numbers

The algebraic difference between any two adjacent consecutive even numbers or any two adjacent consecutive odd numbers is always exactly 2.

questions.question: Find the difference of the face values of 9 and 3 in 3,15,298.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Face value of any digit in a number is the digit itself.

Face value of 9 in 3,15,298 = 9

Face value of 3 in 3,15,298 = 3

Required Difference = 9 − 3 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 3,15,298

**Formula Used:**

Face value of a digit is its own value, regardless of its position in the number.

 
 3 1 5 2 9 8
 

 Face Value = 3
 

 Face Value = 9
 
• 
 Difference = 9 − 3 = 6

**Calculations:**

⇒ In the number 3,15,298, the digit 9 is at the tens place.

⇒ Face value of 9 = 9

⇒ The digit 3 is at the lakhs place.

⇒ Face value of 3 = 3

⇒ Difference = Face value of 9 − Face value of 3

⇒ Difference = 9 − 3 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Place Value

Place value of a digit depends on its position. For 3,15,298: Place value of 3 = 3 × 1,00,000 = 3,00,000 and Place value of 9 = 9 × 10 = 90.

Comparison

The Face Value of a digit never changes, whereas the Place Value changes according to the position of the digit in the number.

Units Place Exception

For a digit at the units place, both the Face Value and the Place Value are always the same (e.g., for 8 in 3,15,298, both are 8).</p
